key_insight: qReduMIS uses noisy QAOA measurements not as the final answer, but as a guide to prune the portfolio graph and enable stronger classical optimization.
engineering_relevance: This shows a practical hybrid quantum workflow for large financial optimization problems, where quantum hardware can improve solution quality by accelerating a classical exact/near-exact pipeline.
method: Model portfolio selection as a Maximum Independent Set problem on asset correlation graphs.
Run QAOA on graph kernels to identify likely-in-solution 'frozen' vertices.
Apply recursive classical reductions, then solve the reduced problem optimally or near-optimally.
evidence_signal: Validated on real market data from four indices up to 225 assets and on Quantinuum trapped-ion hardware, with qReduMIS reaching success probabilities of 0.40 and 0.95 on the hardest cases and average approximation ratios at least 0.96.
watch_item: Performance depends on kernel quality, hardware noise, and reduction accuracy, so the approach may not transfer uniformly across different market graphs or quantum devices.
paper_title: Quantum-Informed Portfolio Selection: An End-to-End Pipeline Validated on Trapped-Ion Hardware with Real Market Data
